summary: Staff software engineer focused on AI products and developer platforms, with 12 years of software development experience. Hands-on full-stack technical leader in cross-team delivery, reusable architecture, and mentoring. Led cross-device Copilot experiences and frontend architecture serving 70 million daily views.

roles.title: Staff Software Engineer
bullets: Led architecture and phased delivery of Copilot Remote Control from zero to public preview in six weeks, coordinating platform, CLI, web, mobile, desktop, and IDE extension teams; preview reached 10K daily users and 30K remote sessions per day
Defined forward- and backward-compatible session and event contracts for cross-client synchronization; led real-time communication enhancements using WebSockets via Azure Web PubSub
Partnered with product and client teams on API requirements, milestones, and user-driven launch scope, balancing delivery velocity against long-term architectural rigor
Delivered policy controls vital for enterprise adoption
Implemented a dependency-graph linter enforcing hexagonal architecture and module boundaries as the service evolves from a single product into a multi-team platform
Grew engineers' technical independence through modeling architectural decisions, collaborative design, and progressive ownership handoffs; mentees went on to lead major engineering initiatives
Coordinated model-capacity planning across five teams. Built a unified usage dashboard and established forecasting standards to address rate-limiting risks

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Architected the React rewrite of GitHub's file-viewing experience, serving 70 million daily views; enabled code-search integration with definition and usage navigation, substantially improved accessibility, and laid the foundation for later Copilot integration
Designed explicit frontend extension points adopted by three product teams, enabling independent development in team-owned packages while preserving a cohesive product experience
Architected an internal AI workflow platform combining LLM and deterministic steps in a directed acyclic graph; evaluations against comparable one-shot prompts demonstrated more consistent results
Made Copilot Chat on GitHub.com model-agnostic, enabling its first multi-provider experiences; integrated repository, pull request, and issue context
Documented architectural tradeoffs and rollout plans; maintained decision logs, including ADRs, to onboard seven engineers and align security and infrastructure partners

roles.title: Software Engineer III
bullets: Owned and optimized the Work Item Query Language and query auto-optimization engine, assuming responsibility for an area previously maintained by an entire team
Improved Azure Boards accessibility and resolved live-site incidents supporting enterprise customer SLAs

roles.title: Senior Associate Software Developer
bullets: Built browser applications and libraries for SAS Viya using TypeScript, JavaScript, C++, and WebAssembly, including a customer-facing data visualization template editor
Led development of an integration testing framework spanning JavaScript host code and a WebAssembly-based C++ runtime
Drove adoption of shared testing and developer tools across teams through inner-source contributions and support

roles.title: Software Development Engineer II
bullets: Developed an enterprise underwriting application supporting group benefits renewals for over 10,000 companies per month; rebuilt search to reduce end-to-end request time by a factor of 1,000
Led engineers in building a Spring Boot and Angular proof of concept that became a standard for new projects; guided teams adopting the architecture
Taught AngularJS and Play to senior engineers and automated more than a dozen recurring manual reports per month

projects_and_leadership.title: @josh-brown/vector
bullets: Built and published a TypeScript linear algebra package on npm, implementing machine learning algorithms, matrix factorizations, and eigenvalue algorithms from scratch with zero runtime dependencies

projects_and_leadership.title: Unicorn CLI
bullets: Built a CLI for SAS's distributed build system and replaced manual steps with an automation-friendly workflow; engineers across the division adopted and contributed to the tool

projects_and_leadership.title: Founder and Music Director
bullets: Founded a university-recognized ensemble, recruited members, and led over 300 rehearsals and seven full-length concerts; managed production of a $10,000 studio album

bullets: B.S. in Applied Mathematics with Highest Distinction; B.A. in Physics; Minor in Music
